text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I did it! That's right! ♪ Machan won the
fight! ♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's a little song I call "Machan Takes
First." I
feel like I could sing it forever
right now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today is my day, after all. My cuteness
and strength have combined to raise my
renown to even greater heights.
Everything's turning up
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My performance today may very well
spark calls for new merchandise far and
wide. We'd better
start coming up with
some new ideas.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's get to a merch store right away and
see if we
can find some inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Gasp! That's true... How could I have been so naive?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can look pretty scary when I'm racing,
so my
cuteness might not have come
across well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Which is all to say... I'd like you to get
your
camera ready, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I snap some photos and, in doing so,
help her
maintain her focus on the next
race.
